主要内容: On February 15, 2013, the Compensation Committee of SanDisk Corporation approved bonuses for fiscal year 2012 for its named executive officers, including Sanjay Mehrotra (President and Chief Executive Officer) with a $661,500 bonus, Judy Bruner (Executive Vice President, Administration and Chief Financial Officer) with a $276,800 bonus, and Sumit Sadana (Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy Officer) with a $211,000 bonus. The Committee also approved base salaries effective February 25, 2013, with Mehrotra receiving $950,000, Bruner $595,500, and Sadana $496,000. Additionally, target bonus percentages for 2013 were set at 150% for Mehrotra, 100% for Bruner, and 90% for Sadana. These changes reflect adjustments to executive compensation structures for the Company's leadership team.
